_about: Short replies (docs/systems-and-items.md §10e, §10f; scripts/replies.gd). Keyed by what's said to you: an ARDEN voice line id or an orbit text id. Two or three choices, keys 1-3, gone after a few seconds; silence is an answer. 'note' takes up a Notes thought in your own words ('said') and puts it at the top; 'answer' is the sender's reply on the next pass (texts only). Your words are written, never spoken.

replies.text: Then I'd better find that air.
replies.said: ARDEN says the cabin's good for about a sol. The cartridge on pallet 1 is the rest of my air. That's first.
Castellanos found my first parachute from orbit. My air's under it. Get to the ridge.
replies.answer: Good. Walk, don't run. Rao says the ridge is steeper than it looks.
Pallet 1: your air cartridge, a sample kit, ten ration packs. Air first, the rest can wait.
Eleven more pallets, somewhere in the Reach. One thing at a time. Air first.

replies.text: I'll find the power pallet before dark.
replies.said: ARDEN's right: the battery won't keep the cabin warm all night. The power pallet's out there. Find it before dark.

replies.text: Can't we just turn the heater down?
replies.said: Heater on low might nearly last the night. Nearly. Better to find the power pallet before dark.
ARDEN says a day of water. Ice first: GAR-Y found frost, and there's the bench melter.
The little printer wants parts from the storm junk. I'll strip some debris.
Rao found Walker 1 at the end of the tracks, stopped. I'd better go and see what's wrong with it.
replies.answer: Careful out there. Text us what you find.
Can't tell from up here. It's upright and its lamp's blinking. Might just be lost. Most things are, after that storm.
